name: Ezbai
overview: Ezbai is a male figure mentioned in Scripture primarily as the father of Naarai. There is no tribal affiliation or additional notes recorded about him. His identity is closely tied to his role as a progenitor in the biblical genealogies.
namesAndTitles: The name Ezbai appears only once in Scripture without a provided meaning or title significance. It is presented plainly as a proper name without additional explanation in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Ezbai as the father of Naarai, who is also referred to as Paarai in a parallel account. No other family relationships are documented beyond this paternal link.
scriptureSignificance: Ezbai's significance lies in his connection to the lineage of David's mighty men, as his son is listed among these warriors. This association places Ezbai within the broader narrative of Israel's history and the establishment of David's kingdom. Although Ezbai himself is not the focus, his mention preserves the heritage of those who served faithfully under King David.
